SELECT c.company_name FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE r.tax_year = 2025 AND (r.non_taxable_income IS NULL OR r.non_taxable_income = 0);
SELECT DISTINCT s.stock_code FROM finance_tax.stock_daily_trades t JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON t.stock_id = s.stock_id WHERE t.trade_date >= '2024-01-01' AND t.trade_date < '2025-01-01'
SELECT i.industry_name, COUNT(c.company_id) AS company_count FROM finance_tax.companies c JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code GROUP BY i.industry_name;

SELECT s.stock_name, (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares AS bps, s.current_price FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 10000 / s.total_shares > s.current_price

SELECT ROUND(((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) / r.revenue, 2) AS tax_to_revenue_ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id WHERE s.stock_name = '顺丰控股' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

SELECT ROUND(((r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) * CASE WHEN c.is_key_high_tech THEN 0.15 WHEN (r.revenue - r.non_taxable_income - r.deductions - r.prior_year_losses) <= 100 AND r.employee_count <= 300 AND r.total_assets <= 5000 AND r.is_restricted_industry = FALSE THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.25 END) / (f.total_assets - f.total_liabilities) * 100, 2) AS tax_to_net_profit_ratio FROM finance_tax.corporate_income_tax_returns r JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON r.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.stocks s ON r.company_id = s.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON r.company_id = f.company_id AND YEAR(f.report_date) = r.tax_year WHERE s.stock_name = '顺丰速运' AND r.tax_year = 2025;

SELECT ROUND(hk.total_mv / avg_ind.avg_mv, 2) AS ratio FROM (SELECT s.current_price * s.total_shares AS total_mv FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.company_name = '海康威视' LIMIT 1) hk CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(s2.current_price * s2.total_shares) AS avg_mv FROM finance_tax.stocks s2 JOIN finance_tax.companies c2 ON s2.company_id = c2.company_id WHERE c2.industry_code = (SELECT c3.industry_code FROM finance_tax.companies c3 WHERE c3.company_name = '海康威视' LIMIT 1)) avg_ind;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS course_name_start_num_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_name LIKE '数%';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS semester_cnt FROM education_2024.semester;
SELECT cl.class_id, cl.class_name FROM education_2024.class cl WHERE cl.department_id = 2 ORDER BY cl.class_id ASC LIMIT 30;

WITH s2024 AS (SELECT e.student_id, e.course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2024.enrollment e JOIN education_2024.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.course_id), s2025 AS (SELECT e.student_id, e.course_id, SUM(CASE WHEN es.exam_item='平时' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期中' THEN es.score*0.30 WHEN es.exam_item='期末' THEN es.score*0.40 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score FROM education_2025.enrollment e JOIN education_2025.exam_score es ON es.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.semester_id=1 AND e.is_withdraw=0 GROUP BY e.student_id, e.course_id), common AS (SELECT s2024.student_id, s2024.course_id, s2024.total_score AS total_2024, s2025.total_score AS total_2025 FROM s2024 JOIN s2025 ON s2024.student_id=s2025.student_id AND s2024.course_id=s2025.course_id), agg AS (SELECT student_id, SUM(total_2024) AS sum_2024, SUM(total_2025) AS sum_2025 FROM common GROUP BY student_id), ranked AS (SELECT student_id, sum_2024, sum_2025, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sum_2025 ASC, student_id ASC) AS rn FROM agg) SELECT st.student_no, ROUND(r.sum_2024,2) AS total_2024, ROUND(r.sum_2025,2) AS total_2025 FROM ranked r JOIN education_2025.student st ON st.student_id=r.student_id WHERE r.rn=1;

WITH d2024 AS (SELECT c.department_id, AVG(cnt) AS avg_enroll_2024 FROM (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2024.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id) t JOIN education_2024.course c ON c.course_id = t.course_id GROUP BY c.department_id), d2025 AS (SELECT c.department_id, AVG(cnt) AS avg_enroll_2025 FROM (SELECT e.course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2025.enrollment e WHERE e.semester_id = 1 AND e.is_withdraw = 0 GROUP BY e.course_id) t JOIN education_2025.course c ON c.course_id = t.course_id GROUP BY c.department_id) SELECT d.department_id, d.department_name, ROUND(COALESCE(d2024.avg_enroll_2024, 0), 2) AS avg_enroll_2024, ROUND(COALESCE(d2025.avg_enroll_2025, 0), 2) AS avg_enroll_2025 FROM education_2025.department d LEFT JOIN d2024 ON d2024.department_id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN d2025 ON d2025.department_id = d.department_id ORDER BY avg_enroll_2025 DESC, d.department_id ASC LIMIT 5;

SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE start_date_key IS NULL OR start_date_key = 0 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE start_date_key IS NULL OR start_date_key = 0;
SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_1_cnt FROM education_2024.course WHERE credit = 1 UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS credit_1_cnt FROM education_2025.course WHERE credit = 1;

WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS elective_cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.course WHERE course_type='选修'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS elective_cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.course WHERE course_type='选修') SELECT b.elective_cnt_2025 - a.elective_cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.elective_cnt_2024, b.elective_cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;

SELECT '2024' AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2024.semester WHERE semester_code = (SELECT semester_code FROM education_2024.semester ORDER BY end_date_key DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM education_2025.semester WHERE semester_code = (SELECT semester_code FROM education_2025.semester ORDER BY end_date_key DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT '2024' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2024.course UNION ALL SELECT '2025' AS year, ROUND(AVG(credit),2) AS avg_credit FROM education_2025.course;

WITH a AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2024 FROM education_2024.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE'), b AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_2025 FROM education_2025.student WHERE student_status_code='ACTIVE') SELECT b.cnt_2025-a.cnt_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024, a.cnt_2024, b.cnt_2025 FROM a CROSS JOIN b;
